scope: Real host/Unreal/Windows tests. No row has been run in this delivery environment.

tests.procedure: Open Player options before New/Continue with keyboard, then controller.
tests.expected: Options opens as a child; Back returns to session without creating a campaign.

tests.procedure: Open options from pause during an active campaign.
tests.expected: Returning restores the focused pause command and does not leak world input.

tests.procedure: Use no look component; keep the original character look handler.
tests.expected: Text settings work; camera/look controls remain disabled with a binding explanation.

tests.procedure: Add one look component with bUseHostLookEvents=false.
tests.expected: FOV works; sensitivity and inversion stay disabled; existing host look remains the owner.

tests.procedure: Enable host look events only after wiring real separate mouse/stick samples.
tests.expected: Sensitivity and inversion become available and each handler rotates only once.

tests.procedure: Try zero/two active cameras, an orthographic camera, a non-character view target, or duplicate consumers.
tests.expected: Camera/look options stay unavailable; text options do not poison a healthy campaign.

tests.procedure: Apply 70, 85 and 110 degrees in the cabin and outdoors.
tests.expected: The actual camera component changes on apply; no camera manager or animation resets it unexpectedly.

tests.procedure: Apply 25%, 100% and 300% for each real device.
tests.expected: Relative yaw/pitch response changes by the intended multiplier without double scaling.

tests.procedure: Apply invert on/off using both devices.
tests.expected: Only pitch sign changes; existing upstream orientation is accounted for.

tests.procedure: Compare measured stick rotations at 30/60/120 FPS and mouse deltas distributed over frames.
tests.expected: Stick uses time; mouse is not multiplied by time. Host legacy input scales are documented.

tests.procedure: Test a game-time frame longer than 0.1 seconds with the stick held.
tests.expected: Contribution is capped at 0.1 seconds; no full-hitch camera lurch is applied.

tests.procedure: Use mouse and stick together and deliberately duplicate one device callback in a frame.
tests.expected: Each device contributes at most once per engine frame; simultaneous devices remain additive.

tests.procedure: Hold stick through pause/options/Back; release only after resuming.
tests.expected: No rotation until actual neutral is observed and a later non-neutral sample arrives.

tests.procedure: Release the stick in a modal, resume, send the actual current neutral sample, then move.
tests.expected: No synthetic neutral; the real released state rearms look without a permanent latch.

tests.procedure: Hold stick during M1.5 return; test menus and new/load session transitions too.
tests.expected: Look remains blocked during exclusive return and requires real neutral after the permission change.

tests.procedure: Take an independent controller look-ignore lock, then open/close options.
tests.expected: The options consumer neither clears nor bypasses another owner's lock.

tests.procedure: Change FOV/sensitivity/text/invert in the draft, then press Back without applying.
tests.expected: Only menu text preview was visible; all unapplied changes are discarded.

tests.procedure: Choose Apply for this session only, then New/Continue and later relaunch.
tests.expected: Values survive campaign switches in that session; relaunch uses the saved profile/defaults, not the session-only edit.

tests.procedure: Choose Apply and save; close and relaunch the Windows executable.
tests.expected: The same five values load from a verified preferences record; campaign generation is independent.

tests.procedure: Launch without options files and make no explicit save choice.
tests.expected: Defaults load but no options file is automatically written.

tests.procedure: At 1920x1080, test every 100-150% text step across all native screens.
tests.expected: Heading, body, notices, buttons, help and save-name text scale and remain usable through scrolling.

tests.procedure: Repeat at 1280x720, including long journal, inventory list, storage and error text.
tests.expected: No required button is unreachable; controller focus scrolls into view. Record real screenshots.

tests.procedure: Open transcript at 150%; inspect top-of-body presentation and scrolling before Continue.
tests.expected: An entirely offscreen body is not treated as presented by the new layout test; explicit later acknowledgement still required.

tests.procedure: Move to an options adjustment button, alter text size, then navigate with D-pad/Tab.
tests.expected: Focus remains on a valid command after reflow; one input frame cannot apply two commands.

tests.procedure: Edit a selected save-set name at 150% and return from options.
tests.expected: The input field font scales and its selected name remains intact; no unintended Start/Continue.

tests.procedure: Choose defaults, then cancel; repeat and apply.
tests.expected: Only available settings are reset in the draft; no implicit disk deletion/reset.

tests.procedure: Using backed-up disposable option files, damage one slot while another remains valid.
tests.expected: Explicit recovery notice; good generation loads; only the opposite slot may be written on deliberate save.

tests.procedure: Supply two damaged slots, an unsupported schema, equal generations or a read error.
tests.expected: Defaults with explanation, no automatic replacement; session-only options remain usable.

tests.procedure: Exercise actual platform write failure, read-back mismatch and ambiguous post-write failure.
tests.expected: No verified-save message; previous live values retained; other slot untouched; further writes blocked until relaunch.

tests.procedure: Change/remove an observed options file after startup using a disposable backed-up test pair.
tests.expected: Save refuses before writing; no stale overwrite. This is not a test of guaranteed multiprocess locking.

tests.procedure: Hash campaign A/B before and after changing preferences without gameplay.
tests.expected: Options operations do not edit campaign files, mission, inventory, world state or receipts; catalogue ignores preference names.

tests.procedure: Switch view target or remove/activate another camera during options, then apply a previously edited camera value.
tests.expected: Unavailable consumer cannot silently apply the draft. Fixed-camera assumptions remain explicit.

tests.procedure: Exit/reenter play and fail HUD setup after options initialization in a disposable host.
tests.expected: No duplicated consumer; owned FOV restores only while it still equals the last value this owner applied.

tests.procedure: Run the retained full mission/storage/repair/transcript/return/save/relaunch loop, with options at 150% text and both input devices.
tests.expected: All retained gates pass in the actual Windows package; capture engine/tool/vendor versions and real evidence.
